name: Damage Meter
description: Damage Done/Taken, DPS, skill details, critical hits, dungeon history and party chat reports.

name: Hide Gold Labels
description: Hides gold labels while keeping pickup available.

name: Cooldown Timers
description: Skill, buff and curse timers. The hotbar flashes when a skill is ready.

name: Nameplates
description: HP/Mana, names and Posse above players, plus health bars for Bling Gnomes and Flaming Buddies.

name: Better Character Sheet
description: Weapon and magic critical chance, stun resistance, movement speed and resistance chances.

name: Mythic Drop Sounds
description: Sound and chat alerts for Mythic drops. Adjustable volume and custom WAV/MP3 sounds.

name: Wishing Well Tracker
description: Wishing Well cooldown, reminders and optional custom sounds.

name: Moveeverything
description: Move and resize player, party and target frames, chat and minimap.

name: Cursor Circle
description: Highlights the cursor during combat. Adjustable size and color.

name: Loadouts & Sorting
description: Gear and hotbar saves. Sort Inventory or selected bank pages by item type, appearance and armor set.

name: Leaderboard
description: Official Reborn rankings inside the game. Open ESC > Leaderboard.

name: Controller
description: XInput movement, aiming, skills, consumables and menus. Steam Deck uses the Steam Input Gamepad template.

name: Enhanced Settings
description: Right-button mouse look, left-click attack control and an adjustable low-HP warning.
